name: Trending Effects
description: Looks made for short-form edits: sparkle, beat shake, kaleidoscope, lightning, clones, cutouts, anamorphic streaks, camera punch, speed streaks, time effects, and ready-made effect templates.
details: Short-form GPU looks plus 23 beat-synced effect templates: sparkle, halation, beat shake, kaleidoscope, lightning, cutout stacks, clones. New: Anamorphic Streak, Camera Punch, Speed Streaks, Clone Parade, Move Subject (keyframe a masked subject's offset, spin, scale and squash with shadow and smeared-in background), Light Leak patterns (film leak, corner burn, side band), and Time effects: Feedback, Trails, Time Echo, Frame Delay, Slit Scan.
